answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 61530 Country: India Title: HALLAL & HARAM Question: 1. I have purchased a flat constructed and sold by the government in Delhi. The condition by the authority is that we cannot extend or add any balcony to our flats. Since there is no external extended balcony provided in our flats. It is one of the requirement for day to day use. The flat owner has constructed extended without taking legal permission from the authority. It it all right( halal) as per our law. 2. Is it permissible to take photograph of a girl for the purpose of sending for proposal of marriage. With best regards. Zobair Ashraf Answer ID: 61530 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1340/1350/H=01/1437) (1) It is not lawful for the owner of the flat to expand against the law on government land. (2) It is not lawful rather it is haram. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
